label_policy.reviewed: Only cases with label_status=reviewed count as independently reviewed ground truth. No current case has this status.
label_policy.unreviewed_repository: Revision-pinned local source excerpt was checked by the runner; expected label remains unreviewed pending independent human and authoritative-doc review.
label_policy.provisional_synthetic: Synthetic source fixture is deterministic behavior data, not real-world accuracy evidence.
label_policy.contradicted: Requires explicit claim negation and positive inspected evidence that conflicts with it. Missing evidence alone is never contradiction.
label_policy.insufficient_evidence: Use when inspected bounded evidence does not establish the assertion; this is not a negative claim about the full repository.
label_policy.authoritative_sources: URLs are review leads only. They do not imply that a source or label was independently reviewed.
